suit.name: MOTH suit
suit.description: Sealed protection for the air beyond Hearth.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: Field pack with pockets and external attachment straps.

map.name: Map
map.description: Your marked routes. New discoveries remain in the field map.

torch.name: Red head torch
torch.description: Battery-powered red helmet light. F or L toggles; aiming focuses. Holster with H, then R to change its battery.

rifle.name: AR rifle
rifle.description: Issued patrol rifle. Loans are returned at intake.

pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.description: 9mm sidearm with one 18-round magazine. No spare magazine is issued.

medical.name: Medical kit
medical.effect: One bandage treats bleeding through the existing aid action.
medical.description: Personal bandages, separate from the community medicine store.

prologue_antivirus.name: Recovered antivirus vials
prologue_antivirus.description: Sealed vials recovered on the hunt with Eve. Submit at check-in.

shotgun.name: Pump shotgun
shotgun.description: Eight-shell pump shotgun. Wide pellet pattern; load loose shells individually.

12ga.name: 12-gauge shells
12ga.description: Buckshot shells for the patrol shotgun.

smg.name: SMG
smg.description: Full-auto only. Thirty-round 9mm magazine. Hold the trigger to fire.

torch_cell.name: Head-torch battery
torch_cell.description: Spare power cell for the red head torch. H to holster, then R to fit.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: Pry open jammed doors. Select in backpack, then E at a jammed door. Makes a loud noise.
